metric_policy: Typed normalized entity names and directed relation-label sets; no fuzzy matching. Precision is not accuracy. Raw/filtered pure-set metrics; strict_raw adds invalid-line penalties and is diagnostic only.
input_context: Frozen data_v2 with independently verified same-source titles; not directly comparable with older experiments using other inputs. Tune is used for experiment selection, not a blind test.

key_findings.interpretation: Low live relation performance is not only an entity-candidate problem: oracle relation F1 remains about 40.31%. Output-record failures, missing entities and semantic relation errors are all present. No result yet demonstrates 70-80% extraction performance.
